edits: light file is the docs favicon unchanged in drawing (black disc, white W); cropped the viewBox to the disc (512x504) with no padding

#000000 -> #FFFFFF on the disc (element 0) and #FFFFFF -> #3452FE on the W (element 1): Winston's main app icon colourway, white disc with the blue W, as on the gowinston.ai favicon and the web app's apple-touch-icon (https://winston-app-production-public.s3.amazonaws.com/apple-touch-icon.png); #3452FE is the blue of the 'ai' in Winston's own logo SVGs (docs logo/light.svg and logo/dark.svg) and matches the app icon's pixels exactly
notes: DECISION: Winston uses two colourways of the same W disc: blue W on white (homepage favicon, web app icon: the main one) and white W on black (docs favicon, the only one published as SVG). Light mode keeps the docs SVG as is; dark mode uses the main white/blue colourway, recoloured from the same file. The reviewer may prefer the white/blue colourway in both modes (on a white tile its white disc then disappears and only the blue W shows, as on the homepage); that file would be the dark file as is. The site header and docs logos are 'winston ai' wordmarks with no separate mark.
